title: Manufacturing Excellence Earns Cooper Standard's El Jarudo Facility IndustryWeek's Best Plants Honor

title: Cooper Standard Achieves SBTi Validation of Near-Term Science-Based Emissions Reduction Targets
summary: Cooper Standard (NYSE: CPS), a leading global supplier of sealing and fluid handling systems and components, today announced that the Science-Based Targets initiative (SBTi) has validated Cooper Standard's near-term science-based emissions reduction targets. The validation confirms Cooper Standard's emission reduction targets are aligned with climate science and meet SBTi requirements. The validated targets also support the Company's longer-term sustainability and decarbonization objectives.
